_comment: Hand edits on top of the OpenStreetMap draft of Lysaker (scripts/stations/draft_from_osm.py), BUILDOUT O5 batch 1 (2026-10-29). Drafted from OSM only so far; facts from the operator's station page, photos or a walk go here with their source. Level names are placeholders until a plan or signage names them.

changelog.what: First draft from OSM (BUILDOUT O5 batch 1).

Draft withheld (not in data/stations): OSM tags no entrance and the footway network has no loose end away from the platforms to stand in as one. Needs the operator's station plan or a walk for an entrance before it can ship.
